_guide: Harness tests run on the server in Studio (src/server/CarTest/Scenarios.luau). Trigger: play, then ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("CarTestRun", true). Output: [CARTEST] {json} lines and [CARTEST] END pass=N fail=N.
UI tests run on the client (src/client/UiTest/). Trigger: set ReplicatedStorage attribute UiTestRun false then true on the server during play. Output: [UITEST] ... END pass=N fail=N.
Limits live in src/shared/PhysicsTargets.luau. They are feel decisions for the owner: never change them to make a test pass.
Only test-writer / ui-test-writer edit tests. The loop is: write the test (red), implement, audit the tests were not loosened, run the FULL suite, repeat until fail=0.
Pushing to main needs /compat-check ALL GREEN: harness + ui + multiplayer + world, for exactly the code being pushed (tools/compat.py).

static_settle.checks: A parked car settles: after 3 s it barely moves, every wheel's suspension is compressed within range, the body is level.
static_settle.why: If the car jitters or sinks at rest, every other physics result is unreliable.

accel.checks: From standstill the car reaches 40 studs/s fast enough, gets near TopSpeed, and drives straight.
accel.why: Feel of the car and the base for the race speeds.

brake.checks: From 60 studs/s the car stops within the distance and does not swerve.
brake.why: PathDriver slows for corners by braking; bad brakes mean overshoot and off-track.

skidpad.checks: At 40 studs/s and full steer the car turns tightly enough and stays upright.
skidpad.why: Corner grip decides the safe corner speed in the auto race.

car_size.checks: The car is about half its original 13.2 stud length, with body, wheels and suspension scaled together.
car_size.why: The half-size car is a design decision; this stops it drifting back.

chain.checks: Tracks joined finish-to-start in Number order connect smoothly and never overlap each other.
chain.why: Track rule 3: the finish of track N is the start of N+1.

money.checks: MoneyService contract: pad payouts are decided by the server, paid once per pass, with a per-player cooldown, and bad awards are rejected.
money.why: Money is the economy; clients must never be able to pay themselves.

race.checks: The real chain is auto-raced by RaceService at the Speed stat's cruise speed: stays on its path, never flips or tilts, pads pay once, the stat grows, also at MAX_STAT speed.
race.why: This is the core loop of the game.

flip_recovery.checks: A car put upside down mid-race is set upright back on the path in time and keeps racing.
flip_recovery.why: Safety net: a stuck car would end the idle loop.

economy.checks: RaceConfig maths: SpeedFor rises from BASE_SPEED towards MAX_SPEED with diminishing returns; GainPerSecond is proportional to actual speed and shrinks as the stat grows.
economy.why: Balancing numbers in one place, tested as pure functions.

data.checks: PlayerData saves and loads Money, Speed, cars, rolls and stat allocation through a stub store; never writes before the load finished; old save formats still load.
data.why: Lost or overwritten saves are the worst bug a game can ship.

hud.checks: HudFormat: the Speed / Money numbers are formatted correctly and the count-up smoothing behaves.
hud.why: The HUD must show the server's truth, readable at any size.

auto_toggle.checks: Stop Auto / Auto Race: stopping returns the avatar on foot to the spawn area, resuming starts at the start line, the Speed stat is kept, rapid toggles and bad input are safe, hidden avatars never collide.
auto_toggle.why: The most-clicked control; swapping in and out must never bug the car.

spawn_area.checks: The purple spawn area is the only SpawnLocation, sits right of Track 1's start, never overlaps a track; walking on the StartPad starts racing with a cooldown.

gacha.checks: Car catalog and config, seeded roll odds (rarest first, min(1, luck/Chance)), turbo every 10th roll, owning = discovering, the auto-roll timer.
gacha.why: The odds are the game's promise to players; they must match what is shown.

index.checks: Discoveries give stat points, allocation is validated, equip works, and the multipliers change Speed gain and pad pay but never physics.
index.why: Progression maths and anti-cheat on AllocateStat / EquipCar.

npc.checks: Each track's NPC drives the left lane as pure maths; win if you finish before it, lose plays out then resets to Track 1; a loss empties the bank.
npc.why: The race against the NPC is the game's challenge.

bank.checks: In NPC mode wins add to Unbanked and pay nothing at the finish; CashOut pays once and zeroes; Stop, death and leaving pay the bank.
bank.why: Banked money is a promise; paying twice or never is a real-money-feel bug.

multiplayer.checks: Two players racing from the same spot pass through each other, both stay upright on their path, and each player's NPC race is their own.
multiplayer.why: Bugs that only show with 2+ players are the hardest to catch later.

admin.checks: Admin chat commands work for admins only, change nothing for others, reply only to the sender, and /tp jumps tracks correctly.
admin.why: Admin commands are a security boundary.

roll_anim.checks: Roll animation timing contract (pop, spin, land, hold by rarity, exit, emphasized extra), compact size and panel positions, emphasized roll rules, the auto-roll pause.
roll_anim.why: Rolls must never overlap or desync from the server's roll timer.

track:*.checks: The track's own acceptance spec (written first by test-writer): length, width, min radius, turns, hills, lap time, checkpoint and pad rules, then a driven lap.
track:*.why: Track rules 1-8 in CLAUDE.md; every track goes through /build-track.

ui_client_rendering.checks: Every declared ScreenGui exists and renders on the client.
ui_client_rendering.why: Catches UI that silently failed to load.

ui_inventory.checks: Every button and panel in UiSpec exists; nothing undeclared is clickable.
ui_inventory.why: Keeps UiSpec the single list of what players can press.

ui_layout.checks: No two reachable buttons or panels overlap at any tested viewport, including phone landscape.

ui_hitboxes.checks: Click areas stay inside their parent and close to their visuals.
ui_hitboxes.why: Invisible hitboxes steal clicks from other buttons.

ui_buttons.checks: Each button does exactly what its label says.
ui_buttons.why: Rule: buttons do what they show.

ui_hud.checks: The left HUD shows the server's Speed, Money and Unbanked.
ui_hud.why: Client only displays; it must match leaderstats.

ui_index.checks: The Index panel lists cars, owned state and opens below the Auto Race button.

ui_stats.checks: The Stats panel shows points and allocation and fits its area.

ui_toast.checks: The roll toast sits above the turbo bar and stays shown through panels and HUD clicks (final design).

ui_rolls.checks: The turbo bar fills per roll and shows the TURBO pop on turbo rolls.
ui_rolls.why: Players must see the turbo rhythm.

ui_roll_anim.checks: Compact roll: bare model + '1 in N', about 12% of screen width, phases in order, never hidden.

ui_showcase.checks: The enlarged roll card opens from the toast, stays open on card clicks, closes on the backdrop, AUTO toggle works.
ui_showcase.why: Click-anywhere-to-close must not swallow other clicks.

ui_loser.checks: The loser screen shows after a lost NPC race and goes away after LOSE_SCREEN_SECONDS.
ui_loser.why: Players must know why they were sent back.

ui_billboards.checks: Pad $ text and NPC labels show only within their MaxDistance.
ui_billboards.why: Track rule 6 and NPC label distance.

ui_panels.checks: Index and Stats panels are mutually exclusive through PanelSwitch.
ui_panels.why: Two panels at once would overlap.

ui_roll_emphasized.checks: An emphasized roll (undiscovered and rarer than the 5th-rarest owned car) gets the longer reveal and the chat announce.
ui_roll_emphasized.why: Rare moments must feel special and be shared.
